irrigation.weekly_setup_schedule.preview_text: {{rain_preview}} Here's how that compares to what your lawn needs.

blocks.content: {{rain_sentence}} This time of year your {{grass_label}} needs roughly {{target_inches}}" of water a week — rain and watering counted together.

rows.label: Rain at your home last week

blocks.content: Not sure how much your sprinklers put down? Set a few empty tuna cans in one zone, run it for 15 minutes, and measure the water in the cans with a ruler. Reply with that number and how long you run each zone, and we'll set up your weekly amount.

This check-in is based on rainfall and weather measured near your home and University of Florida turf guidance. Local watering restrictions still apply — check your county's assigned days. Prefer not to get these weekly check-ins? Just reply to this email and we'll take care of it.
